audit.adaptation_reason: The source supplies only BAE=60° and ACB=36° and does not determine CAF or AFC. Added the single angle equality CAD=BAE to retain the original target and source answer. No extra line or angle label is added to the image.
source_visual_observations: Intersecting trianglesADE andABC; F is AD∩BC; E below-left, D above-left, A lower-right, C above-right. Source shows BAE60° and ACB36°.
audit.independent_solution: The added equality gives angleCAF=angleCAD=angleBAE=60°. In triangleACF, C=36°, so AFC=180−60−36=84°, choice A.
